note: Design record. No schema, migration, route, cron, binding or code exists for it.

entities.purpose: Registry mirror of the frozen source families (area, disposition, authority level, registry version). Identity only; never runtime activation.
entities.mutability: immutable per SOURCE_BASE_VERSION; changes only by a source-base version bump
entities.notes: Seeded from docs/generated/statistics-source-registry-v1.json. `area` = TURKEY|GLOBAL is a property of the SOURCE FAMILY, never of an observation.

entities.purpose: Separate runtime governance per source (and optionally per dataset): state, gates, cadence class, budgets, approvals.
entities.canonical_identity: (source_id, dataset_id NULLable) ; dataset_id NULL = source-wide row
entities.mutability: mutable; transitions to CANARY_ONLY/ACTIVE only through an owner-authorized action (approval ref recorded); machine may only move toward PAUSED
entities.retention: durable (policy history in validation_events kind POLICY_CHANGE)
entities.notes: States: DISABLED (default), CANARY_ONLY, ACTIVE, PAUSED, RETIRED. DISCOVERED/ARCHITECTURE_READY are registry attributes, not runtime states. Holds terms_status, activation_legal_gate, auth_secret_name (name only), rate-limit/write budgets, failure_count, lease (Worker-owned, Evergreen precedent).

entities.purpose: One DATASET / DATAFLOW (or nested HSGM group, SGK workbook block) inside a source family.
entities.notes: Native key examples: ESTAT:HLTH_SHA11_HF, GHO:WHOSIS_000001, WB:2/SH.XPD.CHEX.GD.ZS, SGK:YILLIK_BLM_4, HSGM:grip_weekly_respiratory.

entities.purpose: First-class RELEASE: the publication/version context of a dataset (edition, bulletin, file, API snapshot).
entities.canonical_identity: release_id = 'rel_' + sha256(dataset_id|release_kind|release_key)[:20]; release_key = edition label or source version stamp or content digest (see ADR-003)
entities.mutability: immutable after FINALIZE (status and counters mutable only until then); canary releases deletable
entities.notes: Fields: release_kind EDITION|PUBLICATION|FILE_VERSION|API_SNAPSHOT; edition label; published_at (source), retrieved_at, reference coverage (period_from/to), source_url, upstream_version, status {CANARY, PENDING_REVIEW, FINAL, REPLACED, WITHDRAWN}, replaces_release_id, release_ordinal (deterministic rank, see §9), terms/access context (terms_status + gate at retrieval time).

entities.purpose: Evidence files and capture descriptors (PDF, XLSX, ZIP, large CSV/JSON/XML, or an API request/response descriptor).
entities.notes: Fields: url, filename, content_type, byte_size, source_checksum (if offered), local_sha256, retrieved_at, parser_version, parse_status, store_ref (R2 key or NULL = metadata-only), extraction_json (page/table regions), retention_class.

entities.purpose: Canonical geography registry preserving source-native geography.
entities.canonical_identity: canonical_geo_id = '<scheme>:<code>' e.g. ISO3:TUR, M49:792, NUTS:TR10, TUIK_IBBS:TR100, WHO_REGION:EUR, AGG:EU27_2020
entities.mutability: immutable identity; validity window and labels additive
entities.notes: kind COUNTRY|TERRITORY|PROVINCE|NUTS_REGION|SUPRANATIONAL|AGGREGATE|HISTORICAL; valid_from/valid_to for changing definitions; label variants (Turkiye/Türkiye) are labels, not identities.

entities.canonical_identity: concept_id (slug, never derived from a label)
entities.mutability: append-only; definition changes create a new concept_id
entities.notes: Carries domain (frozen 30-domain taxonomy), canonical measure_type, unit class and a definition reference. No autonomous creation: only reviewed changes.

entities.purpose: Source-native indicator/measure per dataset (the native id is preserved verbatim).
entities.mutability: immutable identity; definition digest additive (drift detection)
entities.notes: Stores native label (any language), native unit, definition text digest. Mapping to a concept lives in statistics_mappings.

entities.purpose: Reviewed, auditable mappings: indicator→concept, native dimension value→canonical value, native geography→canonical geography.
entities.mutability: append-only; a changed mapping is a new row; state transitions logged
entities.notes: state EXACT|COMPATIBLE|NON_EQUIVALENT|REVIEW_REQUIRED (absence = UNMAPPED). reviewed_by, reviewed_at, evidence_ref. Written only by reviewed repo mapping files applied by an owner-authorized job; no autonomous ontology mutation.

entities.purpose: STABLE statistical identity: everything except time, release and value.
entities.canonical_identity: series_id = 'ser_' + base32(sha256(canonical_series_key))[:26]; canonical_series_key stored in clear (collision check)
entities.notes: Typed core columns: geo_id, indicator_id, concept_id (NULL until mapped), sex, age_group, unit, measure_type, rate_basis, standardization, estimate_type, scenario_variant, plus dimset_hash and lossless source_key_json (never queried). Extras go to statistics_series_dimensions.

entities.purpose: Extensible, queryable extra source dimensions (cause/ICD group, NACE activity, economic sector, sex-migrant status, province when not the main geo, …).
entities.high_value_indexes: (dim_code, value_code, series_id) — covering lookup for bounded filters
entities.notes: Chosen over JSON-only so extra dimensions stay filterable without JSON scans.

entities.purpose: Immutable VALUE ASSERTION for series + reference period + release.
entities.mutability: immutable (value fields); only quality_state may advance via a validation event (trigger-limited column)
entities.retention: durable (history normally never deleted; canary releases excepted)
entities.high_value_indexes: PK; UNIQUE(series_id, period_key, release_id) serves history reads; (release_id, series_id) partial for release comparison; (revision_class, created_at) partial WHERE revision_class<>'NEW_RELEASE'
entities.notes: Fields: period_native, period_granularity, period_start/end, period_key; value_status VALUE|MISSING|NOT_APPLICABLE|SUPPRESSED|UNKNOWN; numeric_value (NULL unless VALUE); value_text (verbatim); lower/upper + interval_type; native flags; is_provisional; value_digest; supersedes_version_id; revision_class; revision_reason_source (verbatim, only if source states); quality_state VALID|SUSPECT|QUARANTINED; run_id; source_locator (SDMX key+period | GHO Id | xlsx sheet!range | pdf page/table/row); extraction_method; artifact_id (file sources).

entities.purpose: CURRENT PROJECTION: the latest valid version per (series, period), denormalized for reads.
entities.mutability: mutable by design — only written in the same atomic batch as the version insert/confirmation; rebuildable from versions
entities.notes: Copies value, value_status, unit via series, current_version_id, previous_version_id, revision_count, last_changed_at, last_confirmed_release_id/at, quality_state.

entities.purpose: One bounded execution of one reader against one dataset scope.
entities.mutability: status/counters mutable until terminal; terminal rows immutable
entities.critical_uniqueness: PK run_id; at most one non-terminal run per (source_id, dataset_id, scope_key) via lease
entities.retention: summary durable 400 days then compacted; detail 90 days
entities.notes: Holds reader_class, adapter_version, parser_version, mapping_version, run_mode CANARY|PRODUCTION, stage, bounds_json, counters (fetched, series_touched, inserted, revised, unchanged, rejected), failure_class, error digest, activation attestation ref.

entities.canonical_identity: (source_id, dataset_id, scope_key); scope_key = deterministic bounded-unit descriptor
entities.mutability: mutable; advances only on successful completion of that unit
entities.notes: cursor_json, last_release_id, last_source_stamp, last_content_digest, last_success_at, parser_version. Cursor never advances on failure (Evergreen precedent).

entities.mutability: append-only; evidence/state revisable by a new row
entities.notes: Edge types: DERIVED_FROM, MIRROR_OF, CO_OWNED_WITH, SUPERSEDES. Seeded from statistics-source-lineage-v1.json (evidence_status VERIFIED|PARTIAL|UNKNOWN). Defines independence for QA and editorial interpretation.

entities.purpose: Append-only log of validation outcomes: structural, semantic, revision, provenance, cross-source QA, schema drift, quality transitions, policy changes.
entities.notes: Secondary readers (OWID, CHR, UN SDG) write ONLY here (CROSS_SOURCE_QA payloads), never canonical observations.

entities.purpose: Outbox for the one-way TIME_SENSITIVE bridge.
entities.notes: See §21 for the payload contract. Never contains observations as content.

rejected_entities.statistics_provenance: merged into versions/runs/releases/artifacts (a row per observation would double D1 writes)
